name: 2D Semantic Distillation Loss
definition: A loss function that distills aggregated semantic features S^{2D}_{sem} using novel-view features S^{2D}_{novel} as a teacher to minimize differences between them.
summary: 2D Semantic Distillation Loss aligns aggregated 3D semantic features with novel-view 2D teacher features to improve semantic understanding in radiance fields without relying on ground-truth labels.
